history.prompt: Generate a NEW unlabeled PNG background for a Chinese machine learning textbook. External reference images supplied are scientific mechanism references, NOT an edit target; invent your own readable composition and do not copy a reference layout. Style: crisp minimalist flat 2D technical diagram; transparent canvas where no diagram content, to be composited on exact pure white. ALL individual fills uniform opaque solid color; white and very pale Green #67A583, Blue #7B95C6, Peach #FFC1A6, Rose #C85E62 mixed with white. Neutral wires #4C4D4F. Sparse meaningful planar mechanism glyphs, no decorative card/icon sets. White modules and colored outlines, very restrained pale grouping only if needed. No perspective, 3D, extrusion, shadows, highlights, gradients, paper texture, grain, waves, stripes or uneven blotchy fills. No letters, digits, text, formulas, plus signs, pseudo writing or watermark anywhere; circular operators should be empty for subsequent font typesetting. Reserve clearly sized blank spaces inside operations for 2–5 Chinese-character names, and adjacent to all input/output wires for variables. Avoid huge border enclosing all computation. Aim landscape, readable at textbook figure width. Mechanism: LSTM cell with current input and prior hidden state jointly feeding four learned paths: three sigmoid gates (forget, input, output) and a tanh candidate. Prior cell memory splits: multiply by forget gate then add input-gate times candidate, yielding new cell memory. New cell memory has an unmodified exit, and a separate path through tanh then output-gate multiplication yields new hidden state. Hidden state then a small task readout yields prediction. Need exactly three sigmoid modules, two tanh modules (candidate and new memory), three multiply circles and one add circle, all blank. Every branch and empty operator must have its correct ports and arrow directions, especially the prior hidden/current input combination feeding all four paths. Color gates each semantic group coherently; cell memory main path neutral, input blue, final outputs rose. Small planar segmented vector strips may illustrate old and new memory, no decorative icons. Leave ample whitespace beside each gate and line for later precise variable names.
